title: CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (RODRIGUEZ – MCOSKER) relative to placing a measure on the ballot that would amend the Charter to create an oversight role,…
text:
[Council File 26-0675]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (RODRIGUEZ – MCOSKER) relative to placing a measure on the ballot that would amend the Charter to create an oversight role, including overturning, that may be exercised by a 2/3 majority vote of the Council to change Executive Directives issued by the Mayor.
Recommendation for Council action:
REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present the documents necessary to place on the November 2026 ballot a measure that would amend the Charter to create an oversight role, including overturning, that may be exercised by a 2/3 majority vote of the Council to change Executive Directives issued by the Mayor.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Ad Hoc Committee on Charter Review Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
summary: Council would ask the City Attorney to draft a November 2026 charter amendment letting a two-thirds Council vote change or overturn the mayor's Executive Directives.
